$comment: Machine-readable learner profile. Consumed by the app for gap tracking and plan generation. Narrative version lives in docs/PROFILE.md.

diagnosis.headline: Receiving offers, but below target — a positioning and market-segment problem rather than a capability problem.
evidence: Recent interview loops produced offers below target rather than rejections
Median UK data engineer salary ~£70k; lead/principal ~£85-91k — current comp is already near the band ceiling
Median remote/hybrid AI engineer salary ~£91k; UK senior range £90-150k base
diagnosis.implication: Skill acquisition alone cannot close the gap. The constraint is the salary band of the target title.

calibration_flag.observed: Selected all four offered weakness categories despite CV evidence contradicting at least two; accepted offers below market.
calibration_flag.impact: Directly costly at the negotiation stage. Worth more than any single technical module if confirmed.

constraints: 150-400 total study hours over the runway — supports one substantial project plus focused study, not three parallel tracks
3.5 years at current employer: narrative needs progression within the role, not just duration
Long career (from 1997) invites age bias in parts of the market; position on judgement and breadth rather than algorithm puzzles
Direction undecided — expensive if unresolved past roughly month two
open_questions: Where exactly did the recent offers land, and what reason was given?
Which parts of the Dunelm agentic CI work were owned end to end?
Is there appetite for an internal move into an ML platform role as a stepping stone?
